hook.name: LaunchHook
hook.description: A shared Uniswap v4 hook for launchpad-created token pools that gates pool initialization and liquidity to a factory, blocks third-party liquidity adds/removes, and charges a per-swap fee on the unspecified currency split among creator, platform, and referrer, with a linearly-decaying anti-snipe surcharge over a configurable block window after launch.
